benchmark.excluded: model loading, data/checkpoint hashing, W&B logging, JSON writing, profiler overhead, request queueing and batch formation wait
benchmark.latency_definition: all images in a batch complete together; elapsed/batch_size is amortized cost, not individual request latency
benchmark.memory: per-measurement PyTorch peak allocated and reserved bytes including resident model; reset peaks after warm-up; allocator cache retained between calls
benchmark.quality_failure: abort and investigate; do not silently select a different batch
benchmark.selection: smallest batch within 5% of best sweep throughput among successful candidates using <=80% of GPU memory
benchmark.timing_scope: warm-filesystem-cache end-to-end batch: read/decode/EXIF/RGB, processor, blocking H2D, greedy generation, D2H, text decoding and parsing; synchronize CUDA before start and before stop
benchmark.workload: 32 frozen validation images per class, seed-shuffled within class and interleaved; cyclic batches; measured stream restarts at index zero after warm-up; same seeded stream for every batch candidate

config.prompt: Classify this brain MRI image into exactly one category: glioma, meningioma, notumor, pituitary. Use notumor for an image with no tumor. Reply with only the category name, without explanation.
